activationEnergy.source: Representative range for Fe-Cr high-temperature shift catalysts, 70-95 kJ/mol. Provisional: pending a single-source citation.

referenceTemperature.source: Representative high-temperature shift operating point, 620-770 K. Provisional.

referencePoint.rationale: Chosen so one reference operation is a minute at 80 percent conversion, which sets a legible in-game pace. A design choice, not a measurement.

activationEnergy.source: Representative range for Ni-supported reforming catalysts, 200-250 kJ/mol. Provisional: pending a single-source citation.

referenceTemperature.source: Representative reformer outlet temperature, 1073-1173 K. Provisional.

referencePoint.rationale: Half the shift reaction's residence time at lower conversion, so the steeper activation energy is visible as a sharper temperature response in play. A design choice, not a measurement.
